b.title: Sequence
b.empty: No objects: the sewing sequence shows here.
b.drag: Drag to change the sewing order
b.tieStart.on: Lock stitch at the start: on (click to turn it off)
b.tieStart.off: Lock stitch at the start: off (click to turn it on)
b.tieEnd.on: Lock stitch at the end: on (click to turn it off)
b.tieEnd.off: Lock stitch at the end: off (click to turn it on)
b.tie.assisted: In Assisted every object has the standard lock stitch at its start and end
b.trim.on: Trim after: yes (click to remove it)
b.trim.off: Trim after: no (click to add one)
b.stop.on: Stop after: yes (click to remove it)
b.stop.off: Stop after: no (click to add one)
b.start.auto: Start point set by hand: click to go back to automatic
b.end.auto: End point set by hand: click to go back to automatic
